verdict.rationale: The evidence documents result fusion (rrf, dbsf) for hybrid queries, multi-vector configuration, and cloud-hosted embedding models. None of these is a built-in or first-party-integrated reranking model: fusion merges ranked lists rather than rescoring them with a model, and embedding inference is a different capability. Reranking is a fair axis for a vector search engine, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can rerank search results with built-in or first-party-integrated reranking models
